description.value: Mountain Springs Motel is a quiet, 14-unit two-storey motel situated in the heart of Radium Hot Springs, half a block west of Highway 93/95, with a park-like setting where Big Horn Sheep and deer regularly wander the grounds. The property ranges from standard rooms to fully-equipped one- and two-bedroom kitchen suites, and features a sundeck, gazebo, and BBQs with mountain views. Trailheads, dining, and the world-famous Radium Hot Springs pools of Kootenay National Park are all within a short walk or two-kilometre ride.

address.value: 4870 Radium Boulevard, Radium Hot Springs, BC V0A 1M0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms the motel is open with an active booking system, matching OSM contact details (phone, address, email). Room pages list amenities explicitly including 'Wireless Internet' across all room types, confirming Wi-Fi. No mention of bike storage, laundry, bike tools, or e-bike charging anywhere on the site; the website does state the motel is within walking distance of dining, confirming nearby evening food.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible motel with an active booking website; a useful overnight stop for touring cyclists in the Radium Hot Springs area.
